Name: Sayjay's Calico Cat Replacement
Author: TheRainbowSmoothie
Description:
A replacement xnb file that changes the default cat into a floppy-eared calico cat!
I will work to update this mod with the content patcher later on!
This mod is just an xnb file replacement for the game's default file.
The zip includes the cat.xnb file replacement and the README file.

Downloads.Description: The cat.xnb file replacement and README file. See the README for installation instructions. Enjoy!
